item.title: False, New York Times, Climate Change Doesn’t Cause Both Extreme Heat and Extreme Cold
item.description: Gelles should acknowledge that the scientific expectation in a warming world has long been for fewer cold extremes. Observations largely confirm that expectation. The idea of warming “fueling” cold extremes may play better into the narrative that humans are causing dangerous climate extremes and wild weather swings, but it is factually wrong.

item.title: BBC’s Fake Record Rainfall Claims
item.description: I gather there was 271 mm in Torbay. But even that pales into insignificance in comparison with some of the totals registered in November 1929. October 1960 was also extremely wet in Devon, with 311 mm falling in Exeter.

item.title: Waste of the Day: EPA Missed Obvious Payment Inaccuracies
item.description: The inspector general reviewed just 20 payments the EPA had marked as proper and found that 19 of them were actually improper, as defined by the Payment Integrity Information Act of 2019. They totaled $63.2 million.
